healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate Aircall API credentials with GET /v1/ping.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List Aircall users with the current V2 Users API.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall user by ID with the current V2 Users API.

numbers.get.title: Get number
numbers.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall number by ID.

teams.get.title: Get team
teams.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall team by ID.

teams.create.title: Create team
teams.create.description: Create an Aircall team. Users are added with a separate request.

calls.list.title: List calls
calls.list.description: List Aircall calls with official page bounds.

calls.get.title: Get call
calls.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall call by ID.

calls.comment.title: Comment on call
calls.comment.description: Add a comment (note) to an Aircall call. Maximum five comments per call.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall contact by ID.

contacts.create.title: Create contact
contacts.create.description: Create a shared Aircall contact. At least one phone number is required.

contacts.update.title: Update contact
contacts.update.description: Update a shared Aircall contact. Phone numbers and emails use dedicated endpoints.

tags.get.title: Get tag
tags.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall tag by ID.

company.get.title: Get company
company.get.description: Retrieve Aircall company information for the authenticated API key.

contacts.addMethod.title: Add contact method
contacts.addMethod.description: Add a phone number or email address to an Aircall contact. method_type selects the documented phone_details or email_details route.

method_type.description: Which contact method to add; selects the phone_details or email_details route.

value.description: Nonblank phone number or email value.

label.description: Optional label, for example Work, Mobile, Home or Personal.

teams.addUser.title: Add user to team
teams.addUser.description: Add a user to an Aircall team and return the updated team.

tags.create.title: Create tag
tags.create.description: Create an Aircall tag. The name must be unique per company and color is a hexadecimal string.

color.description: Tag color as a hexadecimal string, for example #00B388.

users.create.title: Create user
users.create.description: Create an Aircall user with the current V2 Users API. An invitation email is sent to the new user.

email.description: Valid and unique email address; the invitation is sent here.

availability_status.description: Initial availability; Aircall defaults to available.

role_ids.description: Role name strings, not numeric ids.

wrap_up_time.description: Wrap-up seconds after a call; applies only to the agent role.

inviter_user_id.description: Optional id of the inviting user; ignored when the inviter is not an admin.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create an Aircall webhook targeting a public URL. Omitting events subscribes the webhook to all documented events.

url.description: Public endpoint that receives Aircall events.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to; omit to subscribe to all events.

numbers.registrationStatus.title: Get number registration status
numbers.registrationStatus.description: Fetch the US A2P 10DLC or toll-free messaging registration status of one Aircall number.

users.availability.title: Get user availability
users.availability.description: Retrieve the detailed availability of one Aircall user.

webhooks.get.title: Get webhook
webhooks.get.description: Retrieve one Aircall webhook by its webhook UUID or legacy numeric id.

webhook_id.description: Webhook UUID or legacy numeric webhook id.

users.listAvailability.title: List users availability
users.listAvailability.description: List the detailed availability of all Aircall users, as shown in the Dashboard Activity Feed.

from.description: Minimal creation date for users as a UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Maximal creation date for users as a UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Order by created_at; Aircall defaults to asc.

users.numbers.title: List user numbers
users.numbers.description: List the Aircall phone numbers assigned to one user with the current V2 Users API.

order.description: Order by created_at; Aircall defaults to asc.

teams.removeUser.title: Remove user from team
teams.removeUser.description: Remove a user from an Aircall team and return the updated team. Calls made by the user are kept.

calls.search.title: Search calls
calls.search.description: Search Aircall calls by direction, user, phone number, tag ids, and creation window. Tags are AND-matched.

from.description: Minimal creation date for calls as a UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Maximal creation date for calls as a UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Order by created_at; Aircall defaults to asc.

user_id.description: Id of the user who made or received the calls.

tags.description: Tag ids; Aircall AND-matches all supplied tags.

contacts.search.title: Search contacts
contacts.search.description: Search Aircall shared contacts by phone number or email, optionally within a creation window.

from.description: Minimal creation date for contacts as a UNIX timestamp.

to.description: Maximal creation date for contacts as a UNIX timestamp.

order.description: Sort order; Aircall defaults to asc.

order_by.description: Field to sort by; Aircall defaults to created_at.

numbers.update.title: Update number
numbers.update.description: Update an Aircall number's display name, availability status, recording state, priority, or Music & Messages slots.

availability_status.description: Updates the first Time Rule widget in the call flow.

live_recording_activated.description: Enable or disable inbound and outbound call recording.

priority.description: 0 for no priority or 1 for top priority; omit to leave unset.

welcome.description: Public URL for the first Audio widget in the number flow.

waiting.description: Public URL for music on hold.

ivr.description: Public URL for the first IVR widget instructions message.

voicemail.description: Public URL for every Voicemail widget message.

closed.description: Deprecated slot; updating it changes no behavior.

callback_later.description: Deprecated slot; updating it changes no behavior.

unanswered_call.description: Deprecated slot; updating it changes no behavior.

after_hours.description: Public URL for the first Voicemail widget in the after-hours branch.

ringing_tone.description: Public URL for every Waiting Experience widget file.

tags.update.title: Update tag
tags.update.description: Replace an Aircall tag's name and color. The name must remain unique per company.

color.description: Tag color as a hexadecimal string, for example #00B388.

users.update.title: Update user
users.update.description: Update an Aircall user's name, availability status, sub-status, roles, or wrap-up time with the current V2 Users API.

substatus.description: Availability sub-status; applies when availability_status is unavailable.

role_ids.description: Role name strings, not numeric ids.

wrap_up_time.description: Wrap-up seconds after a call; applies to the agent role.

webhooks.update.title: Update webhook
webhooks.update.description: Update an Aircall webhook's URL, name, active state, or event subscriptions. Omitted events reset the subscription to all events unless events_action is set.

webhook_id.description: Webhook UUID or legacy numeric webhook id.

events.description: Event names to add or remove when events_action is set.

active.description: True to re-activate the webhook, false to disable it.

events_action.description: Add or remove the supplied events from the existing subscription.
